headline:
Can The Seller Pay
The Closing Costs?
titan_answer: Sometimes. On one kind of conventional loan, a seller can put money toward your closing costs, up to a limit. It depends on your down payment: for the smallest ones it's three percent of the price or the appraisal, whichever is lower. It can't cover the down payment itself.
source: Fannie Mae Selling Guide (conventional loans), current Nov 2026; section dated May 7, 2025
disclaimer: General information about one kind of conventional loan, not loan advice. Your own limit depends on your loan type and down payment; ask your lender.
